about_the_game:
O Segundo Dia is a Brazilian indie atmospheric exploration game that invites you on a calm and mysterious journey. After the firmament is torn apart and the stars fall from the sky, it is up to the player to travel through biomes inspired by Brazil’s diverse landscapes to recover these fragments and return light to the constellations. At every step, sounds become your main form of interaction, creating a unique experience of connection with enigmatic creatures and with the universe itself.

Gameplay Experience

The heart of Segundo Dia lies in how you communicate with the world: instead of traditional dialogues, interaction happens through sounds—voice, whistles, or noises that awaken responses from creatures. This mechanic turns each encounter into a moment of discovery and experimentation. As you collect the fallen stars, you gradually restore constellations, revealing a renewed sky and a sense of completion of the journey.

Key Features

  • Brazilian indie production: independently developed, carrying cultural identity and references from Brazil.

  • Relaxing exploration: wander through zones that recreate the diversity of Brazilian biomes, such as caatinga, pantanal, coast, and forests.

  • Sound-based interaction: use your own voice or other sounds to connect with mysterious creatures.

  • Immersive atmosphere: art and soundtrack designed to convey calm, curiosity, and contemplation.

  • Symbolic narrative: a fable about the creation of the world, reunion, and the importance of connection.

  • Clear goal: recover stars, rebuild constellations, and restore the night sky.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (22H2) ou superior
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 ou equivalente.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit.
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4070 / 4070 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
